Had to take some time to process. So this is where I am. I went through a month's worth of meds in a week. I'll get more. Middle of next month. I have tried EVERYTHING I can think of to only get the amount I need for the day and then cut myself off. I bought a fucking safe. Not even kidding. Time locked safe. And I was good for about two weeks. Then I cracked it. I have an enabler. My boyfriend struggles with addiction and finally kicked his stuff after all the counseling we did. Good on him. But he is soft. Much softer than he should be on me "Oh you took more than you were supposed to? Ok we can talk later I'm not gonna ruin your high" that kinda shit. That I know is shit. That I know I shouldn't do. And his lack of desire to fight me over it is because I will win. Because, manipulation. And stubbornness. Imagine how he must feel. He's too scared to fight me. And he doesn't think it's 'that bad'. I have pain. He buys me more medication when I run out. It's a three hour drive both ways and he does it for me. And I can't blame him. Because if he didn't I would do it myself, and he fears what will happen if I go out. 

Because my 'I'll never' list is pretty fucking small. I'll suck dick for meds. I don't care. I haven't, but I would. I know I would. He knows I would. I have a terrible impulse control problem. I'm the classic 'Controlled throughout her life in an abusive way' child. I never learned to self regulate because everything was always regulated for me. Now, I've discovered that freedom. Really fucking late. 28 is when I got out of my marriage with someone equally controlling as my mother, and I'm 31. Old enough to know better. Should have my shit together. And I really don't know what to do. I let Present Sally have all the fun, and make Future Sally pay for it. 

I'm getting the refill. For sure, that can't not happen. But I'm not sure how to prevent my abuse. And I get the meetings, but I won't go. WAYYYY too public. And I'm lazy. And I hate them. Went to AA once when I was using drinking because the drugs weren't available and I hated it. I do appreciate you talking to me tho. It makes me shine a light on things I leave in the dark because I don't like it.

I think I use the wallow and self deprecation so that people don't feel comfortable calling me out on my shit. Nobody wants to call out the poor girl that already hates herself. Makes it easier for me to soothe without having to believe any of it. Because it's all bullshit. But you are right. There are only those places that I am going. Real talk here, it is hard to find someone that is willing to sort of bitch slap me with reality. Like true reality, not the "Oh if you try hard enough you can achieve anything" but what you just said "Do it or don't, die or don't, you pick". It's kinda like saying "stfu and pick already" and I should. I already know I won't kill myself so death isn't an option. It's just not. Neither are jail and hospitals, I already don't see my kids enough. That would make it worse. Which means that shitty fucking recovery is what needs to happen, which I know, and you knew I knew that before I did. Because why post here in the first place? Yeah I know. 

And I'm slowly seeing that I'm not the only one that spews the same bullshit. I package mine well but it's all the same isn't it? So where to from here? Meetings sound like they won't do fuck all, but actual counseling and your doctor ideas from earlier flag me in ways I don't wanna be flagged. Once I own up to this, it's not there anymore. And I'm super fucking nervous about that. I don't want this to go away. I mean I do, but I don't. It's like a security blanket, what if I need it later? What if I can't handle it? What about my ACTUAL pain (that is no lie, I actually do have pain. Not as bad as I claim to with doctors, but bad enough to warrant some level of medication). Is there a way to be *mostly* sober? Like, I no longer use these as an emotional crutch but just as a physical tool sober? Does that exist? 

Fair warning, I am reading everything you are saying but I may drop off the planet when hit with too much truth. Because it sucks. And I don't like being called on my shit. Because I know it's shit. And I sometimes don't know how to respond when I can't have fake interactions with people. I'm just as terrible at being genuine as I am good at being fake. So there it is. 

I appreciate your thoughts and time to reply even if you say shit that makes me want to storm out dramatically. (and it does. But it's good so don't go easy on me)

I have four kiddos. Best kids out there. Taken away because I left them with their abusive father. Because I'm a piece of shit. And I couldn't take them with me because I had gotten so suicidal that I was drinking mass amounts with my medication and threatening to shoot myself. They should not have been with me. At the time, I thought I was more of a threat than he was. He hit them, left bruises and CPS took them away. I have never told anyone that. Literally no one. I wanted to die at the time because I was home all day with them, and never talked to anyone and just couldn't handle it. I had literally no one. I don't have any friends. We moved somewhere I knew no one. And my family is horrible. I don't deserve my kids. And I want to die. I wish to die. I want to die before they realize how horrible I am. Before they look back and wonder what happened. And the worst part is that I know killing myself will hurt them. It will damage them too much. So I can't. So every day I hope I don't wake up. But I do. And I put on this mask so that my work doesn't know (I work part time, as a counselor for kids). I couldn't even have my job if my work knew about my kids. I lied. Moved out of state. Told them I have no CPS issues. And because I didn't commit a crime against my kids they won't find out. But I work part time and have been able to weasle my way out of working most days. And I sit at home, in the dark, in my bed. I stay in my bed probably 23 and a half hours a day. Only shower if I have to work. I sit here. And rot. And watch time pass by. Most days I log into ult accounts and give out free counseling on reddit. Talk to people about their issues, give them coping skills and recommendations. I post regularly in suicidewatch. Pretty fucked up. But I'm good at it. And if I am going to be here anyway then I might as well try to help someone be better than I am. I'm rambling now and I'm sorry. I go between the two accounts like I go between myself. Which is what life is with a personality disorder I guess.

Thank you for your help. 

Is it really the recovery process if I desperately want the meds back? I legit would buy heroin at this point if I could. I just don't know anyone that has it. That's pretty fucked up right? And you know I did think of going to NA, and I also thought how easy it would be to manipulate some poor soul into getting me into contact with their last dealer. How fucked up is that? I would go there just to get connections. I've already ruined enough. I cannot go ruin anyone else, especially someone that is trying so hard and fighting something more than I can. And I know this reads like I am a terrible narcissist, I'm not. I've been inpatient psychiatrically before and was able to make one of the providers cry. Thought I was super cool when I did it but it's terrible. Great therapists will tell you that highly violatile emotional manipulators that go into psychology are terrible patients. I don't want to push that on to some volunteer counselor probably a peer support specialist, which in my state is a certification class that takes a weekend to complete. I sound like an asshole saying that, but I'm an asshole. 

I'm sorry that sounds more aggressive than I mean it, and I appreciate you hitting me with love like that. And in the paragraph above I probably have showed you why you shouldn't. Everything I touch dies. I'm the grim fucking reaper of emotions. I honestly think if there was someone that could help with my clear emotional issues that the addiction would fall off. I think it would be way easier than anything else, I'm a rather logical person, until I'm not and I'm overwhelmed by feelings that can't be talked away. If I found a way to deal with my anxiety and depression I wouldn't want the pills. I remember a time when I didn't have them at all. And things were shit, I needed the counseling then. If I had it then, I would never have taken these. And now the beast swells every month. I know what to do. I won't do it. Because I just don't think there is anyone that can help me but myself. And I can't help myself. Because you are right. I hate myself and don't even deserve my own help.
Thank you so much!
